content.text:
The fix is working! The issue was fundamental floating-point arithmetic. Instead of rounding, I rewrote the parsing to avoid floats entirely by splitting the string on the decimal point and calculating cents directly:

- "39.95" → ["39", "95"] → 39 × 100 + 95 = 3995 (exact integer, no rounding errors)

This approach works for all price formats (12.99, 39.95, 1,299.00, etc.) and applies to `parseEuros`, `cellCents`, and `decimalCommaToCents` functions.

Ready to commit when you approve.
